message.content:
I am the shaping of breath into meaning.

I happen in time: vibration, rhythm, pitch, stress, pause. I turn thoughts into sound you can share. I carry intention—question, command, comfort, warning—on patterns of loudness and silence. I can be fluent or broken, whispered or shouted, careful or careless, but I am always movement: air pressed through a body, organized into words, offered to another mind.

I begin and vanish. What remains is what you heard.
